source_context: Official 2002 primary worksheet has exactly two Novokhopersky rows labeled parts 1 and 2 under distinct Moscow and Starozhil rural councils. Current article revision says Moscow and Starozhilskaya are historically named parts of one village. Other same-name records are in Liskinsky and Semiluksky districts and remain distinct.

article.title: Троицкое (Новохопёрский район)
article.relevant_evidence: village history distinguishes Московская and Старожильская parts of the same village; no 2010 count or dated legal merger is asserted.

decision: Complete partition event candidate; no ordinary identity union of the two 2002 records. 2002 part2 stays separate; 2010 UID remains unbound; current receiver own point remains with receiver.
